## Où j'en suis
Q1 2027 pricing is ready for review but not sent. The impact model uses October billing volume for 38 active customers. With the Loomly/Pinecrest exception and the Tradewell exclusion, the annualized uplift is +$351k and 5 customers are above +10% on 1 January. The notice is drafted in a standard and a Loomly/Pinecrest version, with the instant payout line removed. (source: ses-px-3, p3-02, p3-04, p3-06, p3-10)

- [en-cours] Impact per customer and notice drafts are done, awaiting review (source: p3-10)
- [prochaine-étape] Gil and Rachel review on Friday 20 Nov at 10:00. Then send the notice from Salesforce to the 38 billing contacts, before 1 December (source: src-slack-gil, p3-09)
- [prochaine-étape] Rachel calls Loomly before the notice lands (source: p3-01)
- [essai-raté] The Salesforce October export had no volume for 5 customers (KeyError on Pinecrest Rentals) after a field rename. The billing CSV now covers everyone (source: p2-02, p2-03)
- [question] Loomly's CFO wrote on 18 Nov that Loomly stays at 0.50% + $0.25 for all of 2027. That conflicts with the agreed switch on 1 April 2027 (source: src-mail-loomly, p3-01)
- [question] Can the +1% instant payout fee apply to existing contracts under the MSA? Hartley & Moss answer Monday, and nothing on instant payouts goes out before then. An agent note of 16 Nov says it applies to all, but it is not a team decision (source: p3-05, src-note-instant)
- [décision] Tiers: 0.55% under $5M monthly payout volume, 0.45% from $5M to $25M, 0.35% above $25M, $0.25 per payout unchanged (source: p2-03)
- [décision] Loomly and Pinecrest keep 0.50% + $0.25 until 31 March 2027. Tradewell is excluded, with its contracted rate for 12 months from go-live (source: p3-01)
- [décision] The flat 0.40% + $0.30 option is rejected in favour of tiers (source: p1-05)
